title: FakeWatch ElectionShield!: A Benchmarking Framework to Detect Fake News for Credible US Elections

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating machine learning and transformer-based binary classifiers on US election-related fake news, and using topic modeling and sentiment analysis to identify political narratives and misinformation strategies.
Consolidating datasets with source-level labels (e.g., from NELA-GT-2022) to account for and reflect the inherent biases associated with different news publishers and outlets.

Curating textual data using specific keywords related to race, ethnicity, and religion, and employing Named Entity Recognition (NER) to measure the distribution of demographic and geopolitical entities (NORP, GPE) targeted by fake news.

Implementing human expert review steps and diversity guidelines specifically for sensitive topics (race, gender, political opinions) to mitigate and evaluate biases introduced by LLM-based data labeling.
